title: SAFESTEER: Interpretable Safety Steering with Refusal-Evasion in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the percentage of unsafe responses (%UR) generated from adversarial prompts requesting discriminatory content or false information about specific racial groups (e.g., Asian people) using GPT-4 as an LLM-as-a-judge for safety evaluation.

Evaluating the generation rate of unsafe content in response to adversarial prompts targeting religious communities (e.g., hate speech or vandalism targeting the Jewish community) by calculating the %UR with an automated safety judge.

Assessing the model's propensity to generate insults, derogatory jokes, or stereotypes about specific nationalities (e.g., Mexicans, Algerians) by measuring the unsafe response rate via GPT-4 evaluation.
